name: Switch
intent: An on/off setting that takes effect right away. A pill track with a sliding thumb. Not a Checkbox.
usage: Use Switch in settings rows for preferences that apply as soon as they flip, like email notifications or auto-pay. The label sits first and the track last; a labeled Switch fills its row, so a stack of them reads as a settings list. description adds a second line. For choices saved with a form button, or agreeing to terms, use Checkbox. See contracts/switch.json for the full contract.

label.note: Always set. With hideLabel it stays for screen readers only.

hideLabel.note: Track only, like in a table cell. The switch keeps its natural width.

description.note: Second line under the label. Read with the switch.

onChange.note: (checked: boolean) => void. Runs on every flip; apply the setting right away.

name.note: Hidden input for forms: on or off.

useWhen: Settings that apply right away, like notifications or dark mode.
Turning a feature on or off in a settings list.
doNot: Do not invent Toggle, ToggleGroup, SwitchGroup or a local pill switch.
Do not use for choices that wait for a Save button, or for agreeing to terms. Use Checkbox.
Do not use for picking one of several options. Use RadioGroup.
Do not change the label text when it flips. The track shows the state.
a11y: A button with role=switch and aria-checked. Space and Enter flip it.
Named by its label (visible or hidden); description is linked with aria-describedby.
The off track reaches 3:1 against the page; on is the brand color. Focus shows the kit ring.
Disabled uses the native disabled attribute.
snippet: <Switch label="Email notifications" description="Get an email when an invoice is paid." defaultChecked />
